title: What are React Server Components?
description: Understand RSC and the difference between server and client components.

data.text: React Server Components (RSC) are components that render exclusively on the server. They can directly access backend resources, reduce client-side JavaScript bundle size, and improve performance by keeping data-fetching logic on the server.

**Server Components:**
- Render only on the server
- Can access database, file system directly
- Zero client-side JavaScript
- Reduce bundle size
- No hooks or browser APIs

**Client Components:**
- Render on client
- Use hooks (useState, useEffect)
- Interactivity (onClick, onChange)
- Browser APIs available
- Marked with "use client"

**Benefits:**
- Smaller bundles
- Direct backend access
- Automatic code splitting
- Improved performance
